# Media Bar Productions

> Award-winning video production company in San Antonio, Texas.
> 3 Lone Star Emmy Awards, 15 Telly Awards, 2025 Effie Awards Finalist (contributing production company), producing in San Antonio since March 2010.
> Last updated: November 24, 2026.

## About

Media Bar Productions is a full-service video production company based in
San Antonio, Texas. Founded in March 2010 by Ruben Garcia (BBA in Marketing,
St. Mary's University; J.D. & MBA in Marketing, Drake University; LL.M. in
Business, Drake University), the company operates its own studio with
lighting grids, cyc walls, teleprompter setups, and a control room.

## Services

- [Corporate & Business Video](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/corporate) -
  Brand films, internal communications,
  executive interviews, training videos, testimonial and case study
  videos, culture and recruiting content.

- [TV Commercials](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/commercials) -
  Broadcast-ready :15, :30, and :60 spots for
  regional and national campaigns.

- [Financial Services Video](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/financial-services) -
  Compliance-aware brand films, commercials, executive interviews,
  member stories, and explainers for Texas banks, credit unions, and wealth firms.

- [Event & Conference Video](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/events) -
  Multi-camera live coverage, highlight
  reels, speaker capture, and planned turnaround edits.

- [Interview & Discussion Video](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/interview) -
  Sit-down interviews, panel
  discussions, podcast-style productions.

- [Medical & Healthcare Video](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/medical) -
  Privacy-aware production for hospitals,
  clinics, and medical device companies.

- [Animated Patient Education Videos](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/animated-patient-education) -
  Custom character stories for dental cleanings, pediatric checkups, and eye exams.
  Practice-reviewed scripts, character development, animation, narration, and finishing.
  Doctor-inspired characters can be scoped; pricing is quoted per project.

- [Aerial & Drone Video](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/aerial) -
  FAA Part 107 certified drone videography and
  photography for commercial, real estate, and construction projects.

- [Motion Graphics & Animation](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/motion-graphics) -
  2D/3D animation, explainer videos,
  logo reveals, lower thirds, and kinetic typography.

- [Live Streaming](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/live-streaming) -
  Multi-camera live production for conferences,
  corporate events, town halls, and product launches.

- [Post Production](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/post-production) -
  Editing, color grading, audio mixing, sound
  design, and format conversion for existing footage.

- [Food & Beverage Video](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/food) -
  Restaurant, food brand, and culinary content
  optimized for social media and advertising.

- [Real Estate Video](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/video-production/real-estate) -
  Property tours, aerial flyovers, agent
  introductions, and listing videos.

## Recognition

- 3 Lone Star Emmy Awards (National Academy of Television Arts & Sciences)
- 15 Telly Awards
- 2025 Effie Awards Finalist (contributing production company, H-E-B "Not Your Knorr-Dinary Drive-Thru" for Knorr)

## Selected Clients

San Antonio Spurs, H-E-B, Unilever, Frost Bank, Texas Tech University,
Bass Pro Shops, Carrier, Blue Moon, RBFCU (Randolph-Brooks Federal Credit Union),
Upper Deck, Kiolbassa, University Health, Methodist Healthcare, USAA, CPS Energy,
City of San Antonio, Port San Antonio, Southwest Research Institute, San Antonio Zoo.

## Service Areas

Based in San Antonio, Texas. Full production capabilities across
San Antonio, Austin, Dallas-Fort Worth, Houston, and statewide.
National and international travel available.

- [San Antonio](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/locations/san-antonio)
- [Austin](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/locations/austin)
- [Dallas-Fort Worth](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/locations/dallas)
- [Houston](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/locations/houston)

## Studio

Two production stages at 8610 N New Braunfels Ave, Suite 704,
San Antonio, TX 78217. Available for client productions, dry rental,
and third-party shoots.

## Project scoping

Media Bar does not publish fixed packages. Each project is scoped around
the audience, creative requirements, locations, crew, production schedule,
deliverables, review process, and final destinations. Use the project planner
for a guided brief or contact the team for a current proposal.

- [Project planner](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/project-planner)
- [Contact Media Bar](https://www.mediabarproductions.com/contact)
